title: ultracraft rendering crash fix
description: fixes a connector rendering crash between ultracraft and chloride with oculus
body:
this mod fixes a crash with connector that made ultracraft crash if you had installed both chloride and oculus upon entering the world

this mod is a very quick fix that literally is just editing the refmap and mixins file
this fix was made by nuhayuponosik so credit goes to him for making it while i was doing irl stuff
also if you are on fabric please support Absolutelyaya who made the actual mod so all credit goes to them and instead download this: https://modrinth.com/mod/absolute-ultracraft
